pull.title: KAFKA-21379: Add mirror coordinator record schemas and serde
pull.body:
Add the version 0 `MirrorPartitionState` and `LastMirrorEpochs`
key/value schemas for `__mirror_state`, as specified by
[KIP-1279](https://cwiki.apache.org/confluence/spaces/KAFKA/pages/406620973/KIP-1279+Cluster+Mirroring).

Generate the message classes, record type dispatch, and JSON converters
in `mirror-coordinator`. Add `MirrorCoordinatorRecordSerde` using
Kafka's shared coordinator record format, together with the `mirrorName`
generator entity type. Unit tests pin the binary layout and cover
defaults, tombstones, unsupported types and versions, truncated input,
and unknown tagged fields. Integration tests verify that records and
tombstones remain readable after a real Kafka broker restarts.

This is a contribution toward
[KAFKA-21379](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/KAFKA-21379). This
original implementation builds on Kafka's existing coordinator serde
infrastructure and is contributed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.

Co-Authored-By: OpenAI Codex (GPT-6) Reviewers: Luke Chen
<showuon@gmail.com>

issue_comments.body:
This PR is a draft while I review the contribution.

Validation passed locally on Java 17:

- `:mirror-coordinator:test`: 26 test cases passed.
- `:generator:test`: all 166 tests passed.
- `:server:integrationTest --tests org.apache.kafka.server.mirror.MirrorCoordinatorRecordSerdeIntegrationTest`: both real-broker restart tests passed, including tombstones for both record types.
- `spotlessApply` followed by `spotlessCheck`, `checkstyleMain`, and `checkstyleTest` for the mirror coordinator, generator, and server modules.
- Apache RAT license audit and `git diff --check`.

The integration tests use a compacted `__mirror_state` topic and exercise the serialized record format through actual broker storage and consumer reads across a broker restart. Coordinator lifecycle and cross-cluster replication behavior are covered by future KIP-1279 work.

commit.message:
KAFKA-20186: Add mirror coordinator record schemas and serde

Define the version 0 MirrorPartitionState and LastMirrorEpochs key/value
schemas for __mirror_state according to KIP-1279. Generate their protocol
classes and JSON converters, and use the common coordinator serde format
for serialization, tombstones, and record type dispatch.

Cover the binary format and error handling with unit tests, and verify
record and tombstone persistence across broker restarts in integration
tests.

Co-Authored-By: OpenAI Codex (GPT-6)

KAFKA-21379: Address mirror coordinator schema review

Use zero-based coordinator record type IDs and explain each field in the binary wire-format fixtures.

Co-Authored-By: OpenAI Codex (GPT-6)
